identity.title: Verify atomic XML save failure preservation

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: 2D-021 requires write, replace, and cleanup failure boundaries to preserve the previous XML or an explicit recovery path without publishing a false save success.

state.current_summary: The existing SerializeHelper atomic writer is covered by an isolated write/replace/cleanup failure contract. Failed saves preserve the prior XML hash and explicit failure state; a released failure retries successfully without changing user files.

objective.summary: Verify the smallest existing XML persistence owner against 2D-021 and record the failure and retry contract for future Recipe work.
constraints: Reuse SerializeHelper.SaveXmlFile, RecipeState.SaveTools, VisionPipelineStorage.Save, RecipeDataStorage.Save, and the existing multi-file recovery owner; do not rewrite the atomic writer.
Use only isolated fixtures and D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev evidence; do not modify user Recipes or C:\Git\2D\Original.
The failure-injection seam is test-only and must be inactive during normal application execution.
Do not commit, push, release, deploy, or perform external communication.

criteria.text: Injected write, replace, and cleanup failures leave the previous XML bytes/hash intact; temporary-file behavior is explicit and a normal retry writes the edited XML.

RecipeState stops dependent data writes after a Tool save failure, multi-file recovery rolls back earlier writes, and persistence recovery contracts keep failure state explicit until an existing save path succeeds.
Debug and Release smoke builds and focused/regression contracts pass with no new compile errors.
Stable contract, current handoff, owner/call path, reading order, evidence, next 2D-022 boundary, and the active 5-minute automation handoff are recorded.

context.location: SerializeHelper.SaveXmlFile owns temporary serialization, atomic target replacement, and cleanup. RecipeState owns the dependent Tool/data save sequence; VisionPipelineStorage and RecipeDataStorage own persistence failure state and recovery transitions.

RecipeState.SaveTools -> SerializeHelper.SaveXmlFile per Tool -> dependent data save; VisionPipelineStorage.Save/RecipeDataStorage.Save -> SerializeHelper.SaveXmlFile -> persistence state/error propagation.

A failed write or replace never publishes partial XML or clears a failure state. A cleanup failure may leave only the failed temporary artifact. Explicit save/reopen recovery is required before Preview/Run.

Debug/Release in-process contracts and file-lock simulation passed. Rendered WPF/EXE UI, toast suppression, ACL/read-permission failure, themes/layouts/DPI/input, hardware, clean-checkout distribution, release/publication, and Original repository remain unverified or out of scope.

evidence.observation: Source review confirmed one atomic XML writer owner, test-only stage injection, existing caller failure propagation, and existing multi-file rollback/retry ownership. No second writer or UI persistence owner was added.

Debug VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke build completed with 0 errors and 16 existing nullable warnings outside this slice. The injected save contract passed 13/0, multi-file recovery 7/0, persistence execution gate 9/0, and load recovery 8/0.

Release VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke build completed with 0 errors and the same 16 existing nullable warnings outside this slice. The injected save contract passed 13/0, multi-file recovery 7/0, persistence execution gate 9/0, and load recovery 8/0.

The stable contract, live handoff, focused smoke reuse, owner/call path, reading order, evidence, remaining boundaries, and next 2D-022 handoff were recorded. The active 5-minute heartbeat automation is the sole continuation executor.
